title: An adopted repository gets architecture and its stack skill
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-15 ("rób skille per stack"): an adopted Python repository gets none of the skills this repository works with.
Why: `krn adopt` (src/adopt/adopt.ts:474-497) installs only src/adopt/skills/ delivery-lead and delivery-retro; the universal `architecture` skill and any language skill (only TypeScript exists, .agents/skills/typescript) never reach an adopted repo, so the brain carries rules (standards pack) but no per-stack procedure.
Outcome: adopt installs `architecture` in every repo and one skill per detected stack (typescript, python, php, wordpress, go, rust, frontend from boilerplate-2026 skills), each free of KRN-process text, under .agents/skills with the .claude/skills link; `krn adopt --verify`/drift report a missing or stale stack skill; existing adopted repos get them on re-adopt.
Files: src/adopt/skills/, src/adopt/adopt.ts, src/brain/first-test.ts (stack detection), test/adopt/
Proof: adopt on the py, php, npm, go and rust outside scratch copies writes architecture plus the stack skill; an outside py row drains 0 with the python skill present.
Predicted: outside adopt == 0 in >= 5 rows
